findings.title: Classify flag-skipped boots before declaring missing backend capability
findings.evidence: The healthy witness emits sound_backend_host_capability_missing immediately on requests==0, before reading the native boot row. Production still asks only under !command_line_no_sound && !command_line_comms_dedicated_server (snd_init.c:96-122). The new backend driver and its coherent skipped=true test explicitly accept a skipped boot with zero backend answers. no_sound is a supported INI option (aphavoc/source/eechini.c:1091-1092), processed during public Engine boot. Thus a correct new native with sound disabled can complete and be falsely reported as still deciding its backend itself. The existing missing-capability stand-in hardcodes backend=1, skipped=0 and does not cover this prerequisite.
findings.action: Read checked native gate/flag evidence before the zero-request capability verdict; require a coherent attempted backend branch for missing-capability evidence, and give a coherent flag-skipped boot an explicit setup/not-applicable classification. Preserve the genuine old-native zero-request red for an attempted branch and add finite flag-skipped positive/negative bookkeeping controls. Do not force an extra production host call or alter the original short circuit.

findings.title: Qualify the census coverage claim and separate required campaign services from legacy UI removal candidates
findings.evidence: The census says every reached route is measured and the rest cannot be measured without a backend, then labels shutdown, UI re-initialisation and the scene scan all required D3 work. Those are not equivalent claims. Original traces cover specific default flag outcomes and SESSION behavior; supported no_sound skips remain reachable. Campaign update routes also reach resume/per-family playback without the omitted scene scan: fw_updt.c:159/232/306 -> fw_anim.c:230/274, hc_updt.c:238/641 -> helicop.c:1568/1580/1595/1619 -> soundeff.c:180-204/209-255 -> per-family play (e.g. fw_snd.c:79-138). Conversely immutable public Engine/module routes provide one boot and frame, no options-menu reinit or shutdown entry, and omit flight draw/scene calls. M5 explicitly limits EECH_WORLD to DCS-needed services; compiling a legacy UI body alone does not require rebuilding it as a host service.
findings.action: Replace the blanket measured/unmeasurable and all-required statements with the bounded source disposition below. Keep campaign-reachable physical metadata, state/status, duration, range and playback consequences required for D3 until extracted or explicitly eliminated from the supported host path. Have Root record the necessary DCS-facing operations/workarounds and the TL disposition of pure UI/draw/shutdown code as removal candidates; do not silently defer currently reachable campaign services to D5 or claim global dormancy.

findings.title: Build the backend test fixture from a coherent hosted metadata report
findings.evidence: backend_hosted iterates its raw report argument and only inserts the host-backend row after an env-sndinit-host-answer row. Its callers pass report(&backend_shape(...)), which produces the ORIGINAL report without the metadata host-answer row. The existing hosted(report) transformation is never applied. Consequently the supposed healthy fixture contains neither required host answer and the damaged-form test fails before its mutations. Independently read immutable source and canonical Linux log: the healthy test refuses missing env-sndinit-host-answer at row 4; the damaged test fails good.contains(host-backend-row). The cross-driver negative can reject an incoherent report for an earlier schema error rather than the intended new backend distinction.
findings.action: Apply the existing hosted transformation exactly once before the backend-specific transformation (inside the helper or at every call), retain its coherent catalogue/count/flag joins, then preserve the healthy skipped/attempted and each damaged/cross-driver assertion. Keep the actual red results; this is test-fixture construction, not evidence of a production defect or reason to weaken the parser.

inspected_facts: Production snd_init keeps metadata initialisation first, the existing no_sound/dedicated gate, backend assignment and later ENV_FXA_BACKEND/load order. HOST_ENV dispatches to campaign_sound_backend; the classic initialise_sound_system call remains in #else. available=true fails before assignment; reference false is a finite unsupported-positive slice, not positive audio support.

C request/reply and Rust repr(C) layouts agree: four int request fields, one int reply, synchronous callback with caller-owned storage. Engine host field order agrees on both sides; enter installs a copied callback/user pair; Rust TLS owns the provider, catches panic/reentrancy, validates phase/boolean fields, and writes the reply only on success. C sentinel -1 and 0/1 validation prevent silent answers; missing/refusal/malformed/unsupported markers are explicit. New exchange contains no float arithmetic, RNG draw, pointer or handle protocol.

The module accepts a dedicated sound_backend function or the existing environment provider, validates function kind before boot, sends the documented by-value table, and requires a boolean available. Reference env responds false without device/file operation. Existing sound_catalogue/duration/pause operations are unchanged.

Observer host-backend counters are labelled host_reply_mirror; actual Core COM counters remain independent. The new driver checks each boot/answer ordinal and count, available=0, enabled flag equality, initialised flag=0 and every actual COM count=0; original and metadata drivers remain unchanged and reject the new schema.

The witness preserves named refusal/cause counters and checked readable-empty out/sidecar requirements, provider errors distinct from intentional withdrawal, exclusive authority output, and forwards unrelated operations. New stand-in tests verify bookkeeping only; none is real native/physical evidence. Finding 1 concerns conditional zero-request classification, not any measured product failure.

The include_bytes test embeds the unchanged repository snd_data.c at the correct relative path and retains the Latin-1 conversion and table assertions. It removes the runtime source-path dependency without weakening comparisons. Canonical C build source must remain the same frozen tree (build/main.rs also permits an explicit EECH_SOURCE_ROOT override); no assertion here proves arbitrary alternate source roots equal.

Old failed DirectSound initialisation sets maximum_current_system_sound_effects and sound_system_initialised=false; the new unavailable path leaves static-zero private module state. create_single/sequenced_system_sound_effect are guarded by sound_system_initialised and the capacity has no caller outside the module except its internal creators/iteration. No new externally observable failure was established for the supported one-boot, always-unavailable slice. Whole internal state identity or positive/reinitialisation support is not claimed.

The five Rust-file final commit was inspected as formatting of the implementation; no source-meaning change found. All 19 changed files were inspected once; unchanged physical kernels, accepted raw oracles and prior reviews were reused.

census_scope_conclusion.word_limit: Under 500 words; source/authority analysis, Root retains TL scope decision
census_scope_conclusion.text: M5 requires the physical services needed by the supported campaign/DCS integration, not a replacement EECH audio/UI product. The census correctly identifies the ordinary init gate, the dedicated side-loader short circuit, absence of scene scan in Engine.frame, and absence of public UI reinit/shutdown entry points. It overstates coverage: accepted default traces do not measure every supported flag branch, and campaign resume/per-family paths can bypass the scene scan. Those reached logical state and playback requests are not made irrelevant by a false backend or a SESSION-only no-op. Required D3 dispositions include campaign-visible catalogue/duration/state/status and any retained range/playback consequences, with explicit host operations or a documented DCS workaround. Available=true is currently a clear refusal and supplies no positive support. Legacy menu toggles, renderer scan and application shutdown that have no supported public route are candidates for documented exclusion and later obsolete-code removal, rather than automatic new host implementations. This does not close or defer currently reachable campaign couplings. The one-boot public lifecycle and any intended future DCS unload/reinit lifecycle need an explicit supported contract or M5 risk/follow-up; no live DCS lifecycle behavior is established here. Source references support route classification, not global runtime dormancy.
